name: Our Lady of Guadalupe Chapel / International Shrine of St. Jude
role: Home of the famous St. Expedite statue beside the door; center of the New Orleans cult and its voodoo-adjacent folk devotion.

name: Notre-Dame de la Délivrance
role: Church where the first public statue of Saint Expédit on Réunion was installed in 1931 — seed of the island-wide roadside cult.

name: Chapelle Saint-Expédit de Mare Longue (chapel complex, RN2)
role: Roadside chapel complex founded by Joseph Tafiki in 1933; the oldest and best-known of Réunion's red wayside shrines to the saint.

name: Santuario San Expedito — Parroquia Nuestra Señora de Balvanera
role: Argentina's principal urban shrine; enormous April 19 feast-day queues in the Once/Balvanera district.

name: Santuario de San Expedito, Bermejo
role: Desert pilgrimage sanctuary (wikidata Q6121548); a major rural counterpart to Balvanera, drawing mass pilgrimage in San Juan province.

name: Santuário Diocesano de Santo Expedito
role: Diocesan sanctuary in the only municipality named for the saint; regional pilgrimage hub in western São Paulo state.

name: Capela Militar de Santo Expedito (Capelania Militar)
role: Military chapel in Luz whose feast day draws hundreds of thousands; epicenter of the modern Brazilian boom in the devotion.

name: Igreja Nossa Senhora da Lapa dos Mercadores
city: Rio de Janeiro (Rua do Ouvidor 35, Centro)
role: Historic center church hosting Rio's principal Santo Expedito devotion and feast-day crowds.

name: Santuario San Expedito (Parroquia Nuestra Señora de las Dolores)
role: Chile's best-known San Expedito shrine, on the Reñaca coastal road; mapped in OSM as place of worship 'San Expedito'.

name: Chiesa di Gesù e Maria
role: Sicilian seat of the devotion in Acireale, where Sant'Espedito is venerated with a dedicated altar and feast.

name: Chiesa di San Espedito (Sant'Espedito)
role: Church built in 1935 in Palermo's Libertà district — one of very few churches anywhere titled directly to the saint (OSM node 266892536).

name: Franziskanerkirche
role: Central-European foothold: the Franciscan church in Graz keeps an Expeditus altar/devotion, a rare German-speaking outpost of the cult.

name: Église Saint-Cannat les Prêcheurs
role: Site of Fleurié's vow — the Marseille devotion that helped launch the modern French cult of saint Expédit.

name: Église Saint-Pierre
role: Historic French center of the devotion; Saint-Expédit statue and votive practice in the old-town parish.

name: Basilique Notre-Dame la Daurade
role: Toulouse anchor of the 19th–20th c. French devotion, paired with Bordeaux Saint-Pierre in the historical record.
